name.description: Baseline name of the `expect_visual` step: 1 to 40 letters, digits, `-` or `_`.

step.description: 0-based index of the failed step in the run (the `{step}-current.png` screenshot).

predicate_sql.description: The condition after `project_id = {p:UUID}` for logs; null when unrestricted.

effect.description: Always `restrict`: policies narrow access, they never grant it.

principal.description: The user to evaluate (`kind` must be `user`).

sample_query.description: `logs`, `traces`, `metrics` or `errors`: which table's predicate to show (default `logs`).

params.description: Bound values of the condition, by parameter name.

predicate_sql.description: The condition appended after `project_id = {p:UUID}`; null when unrestricted.

ended_at.description: Set once the grant has been taken back.

expires_at.description: Approved requests: when the granted role lapses.

data.description: Rules with labelled runs, most labelled first, at most 100.

case_priority.description: Priority stamped on the case the rule opens.

hosts.description: Exact `host` or `host:port` names, lowercase; no wildcards.

ActiveRow.description: A statement of one project that is running now.

accepted.description: Events accepted (a repeated idempotency key counts, and is stored once).

coalesced.description: Events counted into a coalescing window (accepted, not stored on their own).

receipts.description: With `receipts=true`: one signed receipt per accepted event, by index.

rejected.description: With `partial=true`: the events that were not stored.

warnings.description: Schema mismatches of actions in `warn` mode, profile misses and clock skew.

events.description: Events ever recorded for the account (its chain length, pruned ones included).

last_event_at.description: When the newest event was received; null when it was pruned or erased.

legal_hold.description: An active legal hold covers the account (nothing is pruned).

retention_days.description: The account's override in days; null = the project's retention.

allowed_cidrs.description: Source networks allowed to use the token (empty = any).

expires_at.description: After this the token is refused (absent = never expires).

token.description: `wta_acct_...`; send as `Authorization: Bearer`. Shown once, never retrievable again.

next_cursor.description: Always null: an account holds at most 20 tokens.

allowed_cidrs.description:
Up to 20 networks (`192.0.2.0/24`, `2001:db8::/32`, or one address) the token may be used
from; default any.

expires_in_days.description: Days until the token stops working, 1 to 366 (default: never).

ActivityActionChange.description: One action of the event-type changelog.

changed_at.description: When the newest version was stored.

since.description: When version 1 was stored: the action is available since then.

next_cursor.description: Always null: the whole catalog is returned.

ActivityActionTemplate.description:
How one action is shown, e.g. `invoice.paid` -> "{actor.name} paid invoice {target.name}".

icon.description: Name of a built-in icon (`[a-z0-9-]`, up to 32).

ActivityActor.description:
Who acted. `id` may be left out only when `type` is `anonymous` (a failed login, a visitor);
it is then stored as `anonymous`.

metadata.description: A JSON object about the actor (plan, role, ...); same limits as `metadata`.

privileged.description: An administrator or other privileged actor (PCI DSS 10.2.1.2); query `privileged:true`.

url.description: An `https` link to the actor in your app.

accounts.description: Accounts whose chain body v1 rows were rewritten (each got a signed re-anchor).

fields_erased.description: Committed fields erased on chain body v2 events, which keep verifying.

rows.description: v1 events pseudonymised (reported as erased ranges by verify).

removed.description: `true`: the user was removed from your product.

fields.description: Committed fields to open, at most 20.

reason.description: Up to 500 characters: why (the approver sees it).

restore_pending.description: A restore is queued; the janitor loads it within a few minutes.

restored_until.description: Restored rows are searchable with `GET .../activity/events?source=archive` until then.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the gzip object.

days.description: How long the restored events stay searchable, 1 to 30 days (default 7).

download_url.description:
When done: a signed link to the file that needs no credential, valid until `expires_at`
(`GET /v1/activity/exports/{id}/file?token=...`). Treat it as a secret.

empty.description: Done, and no event matched the filters (the file holds only its header or manifest).

format.description:
`csv`, `ndjson` (default), `ocsf`, `cef`, `leef` or `pdf` (at most 100000 events, with a
signed manifest page).

notify_email.description: Emailed a link (valid 24 hours, no login needed) when the file is ready.

report.description:
`events` (default) or `summary` (counts by action, actor, outcome and day, top failures;
`ndjson` or `pdf`).

accounts.description: Only these accounts (default: every account the grant covers).

from.description: RFC 3339 (default: 30 days before `to`); at most 400 days.

accounts.description: Null: every account of the project.

active.description: Live: not revoked and not expired.

undertaking_by.description: Who accepted the undertaking in the portal, and when.

portal_url.description:
Shown once: the portal link to hand to the auditor (the token rides in the fragment, so
it never reaches a server log).

token.description: Shown once: the bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer wtaud_...`).

expires_at.description: RFC 3339, at most 90 days ahead (default: 30 days).

name.description: The auditor or firm, up to 200 characters.

next_cursor.description: Always null: the newest 200 grants.

controls.description: The control mapping from live configuration.

integrity.description: Continuous verification over the last 30 days.

verify_runs.description: Recent verify runs, newest first (up to 20).

accept.description:
Must be true: the auditor undertakes to furnish the records to the regulator on request
and to keep them confidential otherwise.

name.description: The person signing for the designated third party, up to 200 characters.

ActivityBatch.description: The state of an async batch.

error.description: With `failed`: why the whole batch was refused (as the synchronous 4xx detail).

result.description:
With `done`: the body a synchronous call would have answered
(`{accepted, rejected, warnings, receipts, coalesced}`).

occurred_at.description: The event's `occurred_at` (opens it with a permalink).

next_cursor.description: Always null: a scope holds at most 500 bookmarks.
Always null: the whole catalog is returned.

changed_at.description: When the newest schema version was stored.

since.description: When the first schema version was stored (RFC 3339): the action exists since then.

template.description: The theme's display template, when set.

version.description: Latest schema version, when the action has a schema.

body.description:
The exact canonical JSON the hash covers (`chain_body`: keys sorted, no whitespace), as a
string so number formatting survives; hash its UTF-8 bytes, parse it to read it.

hash.description: Hex SHA-256 chain hash: `SHA-256(prev_hash || body)` as in `wt-audit-chain`.

prev_hash.description:
Hex chain hash of the row before (the anchor's for the first row after it; empty for
seq 1).

ActivityChange.description: One changed field. `old` and `new` are JSON scalars or strings up to 1 KB.

kind.description: `periodic` (hourly by the janitor) or `erase` (re-anchor after an actor erase).

message.description:
The exact signed bytes (UTF-8 JSON array `["wt.activity.checkpoint.v1", project,
account, seq, hash, at_unix_s]`).

config.description: `{bucket, region?, endpoint?, prefix?}`; credentials are never returned.

cursor_at.description: The newest tree head copied so far.

access_key_id.description: Write-only credentials, sealed at rest and never shown again.

endpoint.description: `https://` S3-compatible endpoint; AWS S3 when absent.

kid.description: 1 to 64 of `A-Za-z0-9._:-`; events name it in `signature.kid`.

public_key.description: Standard base64 of the 32-byte Ed25519 public key.

next_cursor.description: Always null: every key is returned.

keys.description: Up to 20 keys; the set replaces the current one.

ActivityCoalesce.description:
Coalesce repeats of this event (I43): within `window_secs` of the first event with the same
`key` (per account) repeats are counted, not stored; when the window closes one summary
event with `coalesced.count` is chained.

ActivityCoalesced.description: An event counted into an open coalescing window instead of being stored.

repeats.description: Repeats counted so far in the window.

ActivityColumn.description:
One list column: `field` is a dotted event path such as `actor.email` or `metadata.plan`.
Values are rendered as text, never as HTML.

paths.description:
Metadata paths (`metadata.<key>[.<key>...]`, up to 20) stored as salted commitments in
the chain, like `actor.name`, `actor.email`, `context.ip` and `context.user_agent`
always are, so they can be erased later without breaking verification. Applies to
events stored afterwards.

anchored.description: An anchored tree head covers the last digest's tree.

consistent.description:
Every digest links to the one before, every hash recomputes, and the log only grew
(consistency proof from the first digest's tree to the last's).

digests.description: Digests found for them; `hours - digests` hours have none.

events.description: Events received in the window by the digests.

message.description:
`["wt.activity.completeness.v1", project, account, from_unix, to_unix, hours, digests,
hex(last digest)|"", first_size, last_size, hex(last_root)|"", consistent, anchored]`.

missing.description: The first hours without a digest (at most 100).

records.description: The digests themselves, oldest first, to check one by one.

signature.description: Ed25519 over `message` by the project's live key, base64url.

from_sth.description: The older signed tree head (`from_size`), so both signatures can be checked.

proof.description:
Hex RFC 9162 2.1.4 consistency proof from `from_root` to `to_root` (empty when the
sizes are equal).

ActivityContext.description:
Request context of a stored event. `country`, `region` and `asn` are derived by Watchtower
from `ip` (when a `GeoIP` database is configured).

time_source.description: The sender's clock source as it reported it (for example `ntp:time.google.com`).

ActivityContextIn.description:
Request context as the customer sends it (`country`, `region` and `asn` are never accepted
from the caller).

device_id.description: A stable id of the device or browser install, up to 256 characters.

mfa.description: Whether a second factor was used.

time_source.description: The sender's clock source, up to 64 characters (for example `ntp:pool.ntp.org`).

evidence.description: What shows it, from live configuration and runs.

gaps.description: What to do to meet it.

next_cursor.description: Always null: every control is returned.

line.description: The cosignature line, `— <witness> <base64(key hash, time, signature)>`.

time.description: When it cosigned (unix seconds, as signed).

ActivityCredential.description:
The credential the actor used. `fingerprint` is your SHA-256 of the key (64 hex, optionally
`sha256:`-prefixed) or a short hint of at most 12 characters; never the key itself.

detector.description: The detector (`email`, `jwt`, `card`, ...) or rule that replaced a value.

next_cursor.description: Always null (at most 5000 rows).

last_run_at.description: The end of the period the last digest covered.

email.description:
Your own SSO address or one at a domain the vendor allows (like an emailed export).
Creating a digest for an address that has one replaces it.

filters.description: Narrow the digest (the account is always the credential's; `from`/`to` are ignored).

hour_utc.description: The UTC hour to send at (0-23, default 8).

locale.description: BCP 47 tag of the email copy (default: the session's locale, else en).

skip_empty.description: Send nothing for a period without events (default true).

fields.description:
Committed fields to open (`actor_email`, `targets[0].id`, `metadata.<path>`, ...), at
most 20.

commitment.description: Hex commitment, as the chain body's `commitments[field]` holds it.

inclusion.description: Inclusion of the row in `sth`; null until a published tree head covers it.

row.description: The chain row: its canonical body carries the commitments, its hash the body.

activated_at.description: Set once TLS is provisioned; until then the default page serves.

cname_target.description: Point a CNAME for the hostname here (only when the platform provisions TLS).

txt_name.description: Publish a TXT record with this name ...

hostname.description: A lowercase DNS name, for example `activity.example.com`.

enabled.description: New events are sealed (a key is set and not revoked).

keys.description:
Every key of the project, newest first; the first unrevoked one seals new events, the
older ones still open what they sealed.

providers.description: Providers this deployment can use; empty means BYOK is not configured here.

key_ref.description: The customer's key: an AWS KMS key ARN, a GCP crypto key name or a local key name.

required.description: true: the erase waits for a second member's `POST .../erasures/{id}/approve`.

actor_id.description: The actor while pending; `erased` once done.

state.description: `pending`, `done` or `cancelled` (`approved_by` then names who cancelled it).

next_cursor.description: Always null: every pending request (up to 200) is returned.

coalesced.description: A coalescing summary: `{of, key, count, first_at, last_at}` (`count` repeats of `of`).

code.description: The action schema's event code with the outcome as suffix (`S`, `F`, `D`).

labels.description: Lookup table values of the actor and targets, `{table: {key: value}}`.

observed_skew_ms.description: `received_at - occurred_at` in milliseconds when at least one second.

schema_version.description: The action schema version the event was recorded against.

signed_by.description: The `kid` of the customer key whose Ed25519 signature ingest verified (`signature`).

skew_flagged.description: The skew was past the project's threshold (skew action `flag`).

unreadable.description:
Set when the project's customer-managed key (BYOK) is revoked (410 `key_revoked`) or
unreachable (503 `key_unavailable`): an RFC 9457 problem; `metadata` and `changes` are
left out.

via.description: The delegation chain: `via[0]` acted for `actor`, the last hop called the API.

committed.description:
true: a chain body v2 event; its committed fields were erased and it keeps verifying.
false: a v1 event, pseudonymised and reported as an erased range by verify.

ActivityEventIn.description:
One event as the customer sends it. Every metadata object (`metadata`, `actor.metadata`,
`targets[].metadata`) holds at most 50 keys per object, keys of at most 40 characters,
nesting at most 5 levels deep; all of them and `changes` share a 16 KB budget. Top-level
`wt.*` keys are dropped.

account_id.description: The customer's end-user account the event belongs to.

action.description: For example `invoice.paid`; the `wt.` prefix is reserved.

coalesce.description: Count repeats of a high-frequency event instead of storing each one.

idempotency_key.description:
Unique per project; a repeat is accepted and stored once. Absent: the SHA-256 of the
event's canonical JSON, so an identical retry is stored once.

metadata.description: A JSON object; with `changes` and the actor and target metadata up to 16 KB.

signature.description: Optional Ed25519 signature by the customer (verified and removed before this point).

targets.description: Up to 10 targets; the first is also `target`.

trace_id.description: W3C trace id (32 hex) of the request that caused the event.

version.description: The action schema version this event follows (default: the newest).

via.description:
The delegation chain, up to 5 hops (AI agents, services, support tools acting for
`actor`): `via[0]` acted for the actor, the last hop called you. Query `via:<hop id>`.

anchor.description: The tree head's anchor, as in [`SthDto`].

checkpoint.description: The checkpoint signed with this tree head (its seq is `to_seq`).

index.description:
Leaf index in the account's log (`seq - from_seq`) and the tree size of the latest signed
tree head (`to_seq - from_seq + 1`).

kid.description: Key id of the tree head signature.

message.description:
The exact signed bytes: `["wt.activity.merkle.v1", project, account, from_seq, to_seq,
root]`.

path.description: Hex sibling hashes, leaf to root (RFC 9162 inclusion proof).

root.description: Hex Merkle root of the latest signed tree head.

row.description: The event's chain row: recompute `hash = SHA-256(prev_hash || body)`.

ActivityEventSignature.description: A customer's signature over the event.

accounts.description: Only these accounts (default: every account, `_project` included).

from.description: RFC 3339 (default: 30 days before `to`); at most 400 days.

token.description: The `session` query value of the hosted-page URL.

credential.description:
`session` (a viewer session) or `account_token` (a durable `wta_acct_` token, which may
keep saved views on the server: `/v1/activity/views`).

expires_at.description: Null for an account token (its expiry is in the account's token list).

account_id.description: Ignored on the viewer path (the session's account).

last_run_at.description: The end of the range the last successful run covered.

cron.description: Five fields, UTC: `minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week`, e.g. `0 6 1 * *` (monthly).

emails.description: 1 to 5 addresses that each get a link to the file (valid 24 hours, no login needed).

name.description: 1 to 100 characters.

stream_id.description:
An `s3`, `gcs` or `azure_blob` stream of the project; files land under its prefix at
`activity-exports/{schedule id}/{from}_{to}.{ext}.gz`. Give this or `emails`.

next_cursor.description: Always null: the 100 most frequent values are returned.

css.description: `theme` as CSS: `--wta-*` variables scoped to `.wt-activity` plus sanitised custom CSS.

hot_from.description:
Start of the searchable window (RFC 3339): older events were pruned to archives, so a
range before it shows only what is left (ask for a restore:
`POST /v1/activity/restore-requests`). Null while a legal hold keeps everything.

locale.description: The session's locale and IANA time zone, for `Intl` date formatting.

removed_actors.description:
Actor ids on this page that were removed (marked by the vendor, or deprovisioned by the
viewer `IdP`'s SCIM): show them as "Removed".

strings.description: `theme.strings` resolved for the session's locale (`default` fallback).

theme.description: The effective published theme of the project.

anchor_seq.description:
Rows up to here were pruned or re-anchored: verification starts after it (rows start
after it whatever `from_seq` says).

checkpoint.description: The newest signed checkpoint of this account's chain.

erased.description:
Ranges pseudonymised by an actor erase or event delete of uncommitted (v1) rows; they lie
at or before `anchor_seq`. Report them as erased, not broken.

next_cursor.description: The next `from_seq`, while more rows follow.

pruned.description:
Signed prune tombstones (B4): rows deleted lawfully by retention. When one ends at
`anchor_seq` and its `last_hash` is the first row's `prev_hash`, the verdict is
`VALID_PRUNED`, not a break.

resolution.description: How it was addressed (PCI 10.4.3); expected when resolving.

family.description: One family name: letters, digits, spaces and dashes.

url.description: `https` URL of a font file, loaded with `@font-face`.

origins.description:
Origins that may frame the hosted page with `?embed=1` (`https://app.example.com`,
`https://*.example.com`, up to 20). Empty = nobody. Without `embed=1` the page is never
framable.

dual_control.description:
Retention reduction, hold release, key revoke, single-event delete and class policy
delete need a second member's approval (`POST .../activity/approvals`).

floor_days.description: No retention may go below this (active lock or preset; 0 = none).

heartbeat_secs.description: Silent-source watchdog: an incident opens when no event arrives for this long.

ingest_error_pct.description:
Ingest watchdog: an incident opens when rejected or failed requests reach this share
over 15 minutes.

review_cadence_days.description: Days between log review sign-offs; admins are reminded when one is overdue.

manifest.description: The signed manifest (also inside the file as `MANIFEST.json`).

preset.description:
A preset id from `presets`, or null for none. Setting one raises every retention below
its floor; nothing lower is accepted afterwards.

data.description: Days with events, oldest first; days without events are left out.

next_cursor.description: Always null.
Always null: every active hold is returned.

reason.description: Up to 500 characters, for example the matter number.

sso.description: The project has an enabled viewer SSO identity provider (`/login` signs in).

name.description: The witness's C2SP key name.

vkey.description: Its C2SP verifier key (`<name>+<key hash>+<base64(0x04 || key)>`, cosignature/v1).

x.description: The raw Ed25519 public key, base64url.

kind.description: `hourly`, `backfill` (written late) or `final` (the account's chain is gone).

message.description:
`["wt.activity.digest.v1", project, account, hour_start_unix, kind, tree_size,
hex(root)|"", events, hex(prev)|""]`.

prev.description: Hex SHA-256 of the previous digest's message; null for the account's first.

tree_size.description: Tree size and hex root of the account's log at the hour's end (0 and null before it).

auto.description: Opened by the watchdog (false: recorded by a person).

detected_at.description:
When the incident was detected or became significant: the clock the 24 h early warning,
72 h notification and one-month final report run from (default `from`).

from.description: RFC 3339 window of the incident (at most 92 days).

index.description: Leaf index (`seq - sth.from_seq`) and tree size.

anchored_at.description: When a tree head was last anchored, and to what (`rfc3161`, `rekor`, ...).

checked_at.description: When the log was last checked.

cosignatures.description: Witness cosignatures on the newest anchored head.

failures_24h.description: Failed checks in the last 24 hours.

from_seq.description: Chain rows rehashed in this run, plus `sampled` random older ones.

sth_size.description: The tree size checked against the previous run's (consistency).

jti.description:
The invite's session id: revoke it with `DELETE /v1/activity/sessions/{jti}` or every
session of the account with `POST .../activity/sessions/revoke`.

queued.description: The email is queued with the notifier (delivery needs `WT_SMTP_*` on the notifier).

capabilities.description:
What the invited person may do (default `["read"]`), for example
`["read", "manage_streams"]`.

expires_in.description: Seconds the link stays valid, 300 to 604800 (default 3 days).

locale.description: BCP 47 tag for the page copy and dates.

next_cursor.description: Always null: the newest 100 certificates are returned.

field.description: `actor` (keys are actor ids) or `target` (keys are target ids).

target_type.description: With `target`: only targets of this type.

next_cursor.description: Always null: every table is returned (at most 20).

rows.description: `key -> value` (a JSON object of at most 4 KiB), upserted; up to 10,000 per call.

accepted.description: 1 when stored (a repeated `idempotency_key` stores nothing new).

domains.description:
Up to 50 domains (exact, lowercase, e.g. `customer.example`). A viewer export may email
its link only to an address at one of them, or to the session's own SSO address.

ActivityOnBehalfOf.description: The user `actor` acted for (for example support staff impersonating a customer user).

ActivityOperation.description: CRUD-style class of the action, for filtering (`operation:delete`) and SIEM mapping.

geo_available.description: Geo checks can run (`WT_GEOIP_DB` set; the janitor needs it too).

tokenize_available.description: Tokenisation can be turned on (`WT_SECRET_KEY` is set).

anomaly_enabled.description:
Write `wt.activity.anomaly` events: a new country or ASN for an actor, impossible
travel, a burst of failures. Country, ASN and travel need the `GeoIP` databases.

anomaly_failures.description:
`failure`/`denied` events of one actor within 5 minutes that make a burst (2 to 1000,
default 10).

require_signature.description: Refuse events without a valid `signature` (needs at least one signing key).

tokenize_fields.description: Fields replaced by a token at ingest: `context.ip`, `actor.email`.

effective.description: The region the org's data lives in (null when residency is off).

locked.description: `true` once any project of the org has an event: the region can no longer change.

region.description: The stored region; null means this deployment's.
A region of the directory, or null for this deployment's region.

ActivityPiiHit.description:
One redacted value: where, and which rule or detector (`rule`, `secret_key`, `secret`, `jwt`,
`email`, `card`).

ActivityPolicy.description: The ingest policy of a project.

profile.description: `pci`, `hipaa` or `ai_act`: fields every event must carry (null: none).

public_catalog.description: Publish the action schemas at `GET /v1/activity/catalog/{slug}` (the hosted page slug).

skew_threshold_ms.description: |receive time - `occurred_at`| above this is skew (1000 to 86400000, default 300000).

x.description: The encoded public key (1312 bytes), base64url.

last_hash.description: Hex chain hash at `to_seq`: the link of the first kept row.

message.description:
The exact signed bytes: `["wt.activity.pruned.v1", project, account, from_seq, to_seq,
last_hash, policy, pruned_at_unix]`.

pq.description: The ML-DSA-44 twin of this key (signs tree heads and digests beside Ed25519).

log_origin_prefix.description:
Origin of each account's checkpoint notes: this prefix, `/<project id>/`, then the
account id percent-encoded. The note key name is the origin.

mmd_seconds.description: Maximum merge delay: an accepted event is under a signed tree head within this.

project_id.description: The project id the origins name.

ActivityReceipt.description: A signed receipt of one accepted event.

chain_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 chain hash of the stored event.

duplicate.description: The event was stored before (an idempotent retry); this is the first copy's receipt.

index.description: The event's position in the request.

leaf_index.description: 0-based leaf of the account's Merkle log.

seq.description: Chain position (1-based) in the account's hash chain.

sth_promise_by.description: A signed tree head with at least `leaf_index + 1` leaves exists by then.

path.description:
Dot path starting `metadata.` (object keys, `*` = any key) or `changes.<field>` (`*` = every
change), for example `metadata.card.number` or `changes.password`.

detectors.description:
Always on, in mask mode: values under secret-looking keys, keys and tokens, JWTs,
emails, card numbers (Luhn-checked).

configured.description: `false`: residency is off on this deployment (`WT_REGION` / `WT_REGIONS` unset or wrong).

error.description: Why the config was rejected, when it was.

next_cursor.description: Always null: the directory is one page.
Always null: the newest 500.

ok.description: The archive restored completely and intact.

seq_ok.description: `seq` runs without a gap inside the archive.

sha_ok.description: SHA-256 of the object matches the archive record.

days.description: 30 to 3650 (default 365). Events are pruned by received time; the chain stays verifiable.

active.description: false once `locked_until` has passed (the lock then binds nothing).

confirm.description: The project id, typed again: the lock cannot be undone, not even by Watchtower.

RFC 3339, at least one day and at most ten years ahead. An active lock can only move
later.

min_days.description: 30 to 3650: retention can never go below this while locked.

preset.description: Optional preset the lock implements (its floor must not exceed `min_days`).

certificate.description: The newest certificate (issued at the lock and at each extension).

actions.description: Exact actions or prefixes ending in `*`; empty matches every action.

priority.description: Higher wins when several policies match one event.

next_cursor.description: Always null: every policy (up to 50) is returned.

actions.description: Up to 50 actions or `prefix*` patterns; empty = every action.

days.description:
1 to 3650, never below the floor. Longer than the account's retention: the prune stops
before the oldest event the policy keeps. Shorter: once past it, the event's committed
fields (actor, IP, user agent, committed metadata) are erased in place, so the chain keeps
verifying; v1 events wait for the prefix prune.

min_days.description: The floor: no retention (project, account or class policy) may go below it.

online_days.description: How long events must stay immediately searchable (not only in a cold archive).

token.description: A token shown in place of `context.ip` or `actor.email`.

events.description: Events in the reviewed range when it was signed off.

kind.description: `log` (events reviewed through `to`) or `auditable_events` (the action catalog, AU-2).

snapshot.description: What was reviewed: chain verification of the account, open findings, or the catalog.

from.description: RFC 3339; `to` defaults to now, `from` to `to` minus the cadence (or 1 day).

auditable_events_reviewed_at.description: When the action catalog was last reviewed (AU-2: at least yearly).

channel.description: `{kind, to?}`: the Slack and webhook URLs are not returned.

signing_secret.description:
`webhook` only, and only in the response that set the channel: the HMAC secret of
`X-Watchtower-Signature` (`t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<unix>." + body)>`).

threshold.description: `{count, window_secs, group_by?}`, `null` when every match notifies.

event_id.description: The event that triggered it (the last one counted, for a threshold).

matched.description: Threshold rules: how many matches the window held.

recipient.description: The address of an email rule.

channel.description: A new channel, same shapes as on create.

threshold.description: A new threshold; `null` makes every match notify again.

account_id.description: Project path only: a rule over one account's events (default: every account).

channel.description:
`{kind: "email", to}`, `{kind: "slack", url}` (a Slack incoming webhook) or
`{kind: "webhook", url}`.

match.description:
`{actions: [..], outcome?, severity?}`. Actions are exact names or prefixes ending in `*`
(`*` alone matches every action); `severity` is a minimum.

name.description: 1 to 100 characters.

threshold.description:
`{count, window_secs, group_by?}`: notify once `count` (2 to 1000) matching events land
within `window_secs` (60 to 86400), counted per `actor`, `ip` or `account` (default: all
together), e.g. 5 bulk exports by one actor in 10 minutes. A group notifies once per window.

account_id.description: The account the events go to (default `sample`).

accepted.description: Events accepted; a repeated call writes the same idempotency keys and stores nothing new.

q.description: The qualifier search string, as sent in the feed's `q`.

next_cursor.description: Always null: an account holds at most 50 views.

params.description: String values only, up to 20 keys.

ActivitySchema.description: One version of an action schema.

code.description:
Stable machine code (6 of `A-Z0-9`), stamped on the action's events as `code` with a
suffix `S`/`F`/`D` for success, failure or denied.

created_at.description: When this version was stored: the event-type changelog ("available since").

imported.description: Actions that got a schema (version 1, mode `warn`).

skipped.description: Actions that already had a schema; left as they were.

actor_metadata_schema.description: JSON Schema subset for `actor.metadata` (default: any object).

code.description:
Stable event code: 6 of `A-Z0-9` (e.g. `AUTH01`); events get `code` = it plus `S`, `F`
or `D` by outcome. Property descriptions (`description`) and `"x-viewer": "hidden"` on a
property (kept from end-customer viewers) are part of the schemas.

description.description: Shown in the viewer action catalog; up to 1024 characters.

metadata_schema.description: JSON Schema subset for `metadata` (default: any object).

target_metadata_schema.description: JSON Schema subset for each `targets[].metadata` (default: any object).

target_types.description: Allowed target types, up to 50 (default: any).

ActivitySchemaSuggestion.description: A draft schema inferred from recent events.

samples.description: How many recent events the draft was inferred from.

base_url.description: The SCIM 2.0 base URL to give the `IdP` (`.../v2`; `Users` and `Groups` below it).

token.description: The bearer secret: only in the answer that created it, never again.

last_seen_at.description: Events received after this are new to this viewer.

stored.description: `server` (account tokens) or `browser` (sessions keep the marker in `localStorage`).

at.description: RFC 3339 (default now; never in the future, never moves back).

token.description: Viewer token; send as `Authorization: Bearer` to `/v1/activity/feed`. Shown once.

url.description: The hosted page for this session.

account_id.description: The end-user account whose log the session shows.

actions.description:
Only these actions: exact names or prefixes like `invoice.*` (up to 50). Enforced on
every read; the viewer's own filters can only narrow it.

locale.description: BCP 47 tag such as `de` or `pt-BR`: picks theme strings and date formatting.

member_since.description: RFC 3339: the member joined then; earlier events stay hidden (membership window).

member_until.description: RFC 3339: the member left then; later events stay hidden.

q.description: A fixed pre-filter in the search language (`-actor_type:support`), `ANDed` with every read.

sub_scope.description: Show only events about one object of the account (for example one workspace).

ActivitySetupStatus.description: The onboarding checklist; each flag is whether the step has happened.

first_event.description: An event outside the `sample` account (Watchtower's own `wt.*` events do not count).

first_session.description: A viewer session minted by your backend.

key_created.description: A live secret credential with scope `ingest:activity`.

is_default.description: Applied when the page opens without filters.

link.description: The short link: the hosted page with `?view=<slug>` (add `&session=` or sign in).

next_cursor.description: Always null: at most 100 shared views.
Always null: a project holds at most 100 shared views.

is_default.description: Applied when a viewer opens the page without filters (replaces the old default).

params.description: String values only, up to 20 keys (`order`, `range`, `from`, `to`, `action`, ...).

ActivitySignedDocument.description:
A signed JSON document: `message` holds the exact signed bytes (verify those, not a
re-serialisation), signed Ed25519 with the project key `kid` (`GET /v1/activity/keys` or
`public_key` here). Unsigned when the server has no signing key (`WT_SECRET_KEY`).

public_key.description: base64url raw Ed25519 public key of `kid`.

anchor.description:
`{top, index, size, path[], receipts[]}` once anchored: the head's inclusion path to the
anchored hash `top` and each target's receipt (`kind`: rfc3161, git, rekor, ots, arweave).

message.description:
The exact signed bytes: `["wt.activity.merkle.v1", project, account, from_seq, to_seq,
root]`.

mmd_seconds.description: Published maximum merge delay: events are under a signed head within this many seconds.

note.description:
The head as a C2SP `tlog-checkpoint` signed note (origin
`watchtower.dev/activity/<project id>/<account>`, key name = origin, Ed25519), with every
witness cosignature line (C2SP `tlog-cosignature` v1) appended.

pq_signature.description: ML-DSA-44 over `message` by the post-quantum half of `kid`, base64url.

size.description: Leaves in the tree: the chain hashes of seqs `from_seq..=to_seq`.

secret.description:
Only in the answer of a `PUT` that generated it (Auth0, Okta): configure it as the
`Authorization` header in the vendor; it is not shown again.

url.description: Where the vendor sends events (path; prefix your API origin).

account_id.description: The account when the path finds nothing (default `_project`).

account_path.description: Dotted path into each vendor event naming the account (e.g. `data.organization_id`).

secret.description:
`WorkOS`: the webhook secret; Clerk: the `whsec_...` signing secret (both required).
Auth0 and Okta: leave out to have one generated (or send your own, 24+ characters).

next_cursor.description: Always null (one source per kind).

key.description: The group: an action, actor id, outcome, or a day (`2026-10-31`).

label.description: A display name when there is one (the actor's or target's latest name).

aws_principal.description:
`s3`/`eventbridge`: the platform IAM principal to trust; `null` when role assumption is
not configured on this server (use access keys).

cursor.description: `received_at` of the last delivered event: delivery resumes after it.

daily.description: `[{day, delivered, failed, bytes}]` of the last 7 UTC days.

delivered_24h.description: Events delivered, events in failed batches, and bytes sent in the last 24 hours.

dropped_too_old_24h.description: Events skipped by the age limit in the last 24 hours.

effective_max_age_hours.description: The limit that applies (the stricter of the stream's and the destination's); `null`: none.

external_id.description: `s3`/`eventbridge`: the `sts:ExternalId` to require in the role's trust policy.

headers.description: Names of the custom headers (values are never returned).

lag_seconds.description: Seconds between now and the cursor (how far delivery is behind; about 60 s when idle).

mask.description: The PII mask, `null` when nothing is masked.

match.description: The event filter, `null` when every event is streamed.

max_age_hours.description: The stream's own age limit in hours.

signing_secret.description: `webhook` only, and only in the create response: the Standard Webhooks signing secret.

state.description:
`active`, `paused`, `error` (retries exhausted) or `invalid` (the destination refused the
credentials). Fix the config or credentials, or set `active`, to re-test and resume.

dropped_too_old.description: Events the destination's age limit skipped in this batch.

from.description: `received_at` of the first and last event sent.

next_retry_at.description: When the stream retries after this failure.

resend_pending.description: A resend of this attempt is queued.

status.description: The destination's HTTP status when it answered.

headers.description: Replace every custom header (`{}` removes them); values are write-only.

match.description: A new event filter (same shape as on create); `null` streams every event again.

max_age_hours.description: A new age limit in hours; `null` removes the stream's own (the kind's stays).

notify_email.description: Who else gets the email when the stream breaks; `""` removes it.

state.description: `active` (resume; clears the error and re-tests) or `paused`.

from.description:
RFC 3339, within retention and not in the future: every event received from then on is
delivered again (at least once; the event `id` is the dedupe key).

account_id.description: Project path only: stream one account's events (default: every account of the project).

config.description:
`s3`: `bucket`, `region`, `endpoint`, `prefix`, `role_arn` (assume this IAM role with the
stream's `external_id` instead of access keys). `gcs`: `bucket`, `prefix`. `azure_blob`:
`account`, `container`, `prefix`. `webhook`: `url`. `https`: `url`, `header` (auth header
name, default `authorization`). `syslog`: `host`, `port`, `app_name` (TLS). `kafka`:
`brokers`, `topic`, `tls`. `event_hubs`: `namespace`, `hub`. `datadog`: `site`.
`splunk_hec`: `url`, `index`, `sourcetype`. `sentinel`: `tenant_id`, `client_id`,
`endpoint` (DCE), `dcr_id`, `stream`. `elastic`: `url`, `index`. `snowflake`: `account`,
`user`, `database`, `schema`, `table` (`event_id, occurred_at, account_id, data VARIANT`),
`warehouse`, `role`. `sumo`: `category`. `panther`: `url`. `crowdstrike`: `url`, `index`,
`source`, `sourcetype`. `google_secops`: `customer_id`, `log_type`, `region`.
`eventbridge`: `region`, `event_bus`, `source`, `detail_type`, `role_arn`. `coralogix`:
`domain`, `application_name`, `subsystem_name`. `datadog` also takes `team` (a `team:`
tag). `loki`: `url`, `tenant` (`X-Scope-OrgID`), `labels` (up to 10). `new_relic`: `region`
(`us`, `eu`, `fedramp`). `google_cloud_logging`: `project_id`, `log_id`. `otlp`: `url` (the
collector; `/v1/logs` is added), `service_name`. `cribl`: `url` (HTTP bulk source).

credentials.description:
Write-only. `s3`/`eventbridge`: `access_key_id`, `secret_access_key` (none with
`role_arn`). `gcs`: `access_key_id`, `secret_access_key` (HMAC keys) or
`service_account_json`. `azure_blob`: `sas_token`. `https`: `header_value`. `kafka`:
`sasl_mechanism` (`PLAIN`, `SCRAM-SHA-256`, `SCRAM-SHA-512`), `username`, `password`
(needs `tls: true`). `event_hubs`: `connection_string`. `datadog`: `api_key`.
`splunk_hec`: `token`. `sentinel`: `client_secret`. `elastic`: `api_key`, or `username` and
`password`. `snowflake`: `private_key` (PKCS#8 PEM). `sumo`: `url` (HTTP source URL).
`panther`: `bearer_token`. `crowdstrike`: `token`. `google_secops`: `service_account_json`.
`coralogix`: `api_key`. `loki`: `username` and `password`, or `bearer` (optional).
`new_relic`: `license_key`. `google_cloud_logging`: `service_account_json`. `cribl`:
`token`. `otlp`: none (use `headers`).

format.description:
`json` (default, the API's Event v2), `ocsf`, or `cef`/`leef` (syslog, https, kafka,
event hubs, object stores, sumo, splunk, crowdstrike, cribl).

headers.description:
`https`, `webhook`, `otlp`, `loki`, `cribl`: up to 10 extra headers `{name: value}`.
Write-only: values are sealed, responses list the names.

mask.description:
Mask personal data for this destination only: `{paths: [..], ip, email, pii_keys,
mode: redact|hash}` (`hash` keeps equal values equal, keyed per stream).

match.description:
Only events that match, with the alert rules' matcher: `{actions: [..], outcome?,
severity?}` (actions exact or prefixes ending in `*`, `severity` a minimum). Default: all.

max_age_hours.description:
Skip (and count) events received longer ago than this when delivery catches up after a
pause or outage, 1 to 8760. Datadog (18 h), New Relic (48 h), Loki (168 h) and Google
Cloud Logging (720 h) have their own limit, which applies too.

notify_email.description: Who else gets the email when the stream breaks (the org admins always do).

configured.description: false: the operator has not published a list (`WT_ACTIVITY_SUBPROCESSORS`).

region.description: The org's pinned data region (null: the default region).

metadata.description: A JSON object about the object; same limits as `metadata`.

url.description: An http(s) link to the object in your app (the viewer links to it).

ActivityTheme.description:
One theme. Every key is optional; an unset key falls through to the org default, then to the
built-in look.

actions.description: Display template per action name (up to 500).

columns.description: List columns (up to 8); unset = the built-in columns.

customCss.description: Up to 20 KB, sanitised on write and on render, scoped under `.wt-activity`.

detailFields.description: Event paths shown in the detail view, in order (up to 30).

environmentLabel.description: Banner on the hosted page, e.g. `Sandbox` for a test-mode project (up to 32 characters).

hideAccessEvents.description: Hide the reserved `wt.activity.*` access events from the viewer list.

hideActorTypes.description: Actor types the viewer never shows (for example `support`, `employee`), up to 20.

hideCredentialTypes.description: Credential types the viewer never shows (for example `api_key`), up to 20.

hideWatchtowerBadge.description: Honoured only on plans that allow removing the badge.

showImpersonation.description: Show "via support" when an event has `on_behalf_of` (default on).

showLocation.description: Show the country derived from the IP.

strings.description:
Copy overrides per locale (`{"default": {"title": ...}, "de": {...}}`, up to 20
locales): per locale up to 50 keys `[a-zA-Z_]`, values up to 256. A flat `{key: text}`
map is accepted as `default`. Lookup: `default`, then the language, then the locale.

badge_entitled.description: Whether the org's plan lets `hideWatchtowerBadge` take effect.

warnings.description: Contrast warnings of the draft (never blocking).

url.description: The hosted page showing the draft; valid until `expires_at`. Shown once.

retrievable.description: Searchable right now with no restore.

online_days.description: Days every event stays searchable without a restore (hot plus warm).

online_days_required.description: The preset's online requirement (e.g. PCI 10.5.1: 90 days immediately available).

restore_eta_secs.description:
Expected seconds from `POST .../archives/{id}/restore` to searchable, from restore tests
(null until one ran).

restored_rows.description: Rows restored from archives and searchable now (`GET .../events?source=archive`).

account_id.description: Dashboard only: take the action vocabulary from this account (default: the project).

text.description: The question, 1 to 2000 bytes, for example "failed logins by bots last week".

assumptions.description: Every guess the model made (for example "last week = the previous 7 days").

error.description: The parser's message for the last draft when `q` is `null`.

explanation.description: What the query does, in one or two sentences.

q.description: The search in the activity query language; `null` when no draft parsed.

notified.description: Levels (80, 100) whose notice went out today.

percent.description: `events / limit` in percent, rounded down; `null` when unlimited.

event.description: The event as it would be stored (redacted; `id` is nil).

missing_template.description: The published theme has no display template for the action.

ok.description: Whether ingest would accept the event.

pii.description: Values the redaction rules or detectors would replace.

warnings.description: Schema mismatches of an action in `warn` mode.

url.description: The hosted page as the account sees it (read only, 15 minutes). Shown once.

erased_fields.description:
Committed fields erased on request (value and salt gone, commitment kept); they do not
break the chain.

ActivityViaHop.description: One hop of a stored event's delegation chain (`signed_by`: the key that verified `sig`).

ActivityViaHopIn.description:
One hop of the delegation chain as sent. `via[0]` acted for the event's `actor`, each later
hop for the one before; the last hop is the one that called you. `sig` is an Ed25519
signature `{kid, alg: "ed25519", sig}` by a key registered at `PUT .../signing-keys` over the
canonical JSON of the event as sent without `signature` and without every hop's `sig`.

approved_by.description: Who approved this hop's action (human in the loop).

model.description: The AI model of an agent hop, e.g. `claude-opus-4`.

tool.description: The tool or function the agent called.

redirect_uris.description: Register every one of these as a redirect URI at the `IdP`.

account_claim.description: ID-token claim that names the account (`sub`, `email` or any string claim, e.g. `org_id`).

allowed_accounts.description: Only these accounts may sign in (empty = any account the claim names).

caps_claim.description: Claim with the user's groups (string or list), mapped through `caps_map`.

caps_map.description:
Group to capabilities, e.g. `{"auditors": ["read", "export"], "it": ["read", "manage_streams"]}`.
Empty: every signed-in user gets `["read"]`. Set: a user in none of the groups is refused.

client_secret.description: Required the first time; omit to keep the stored secret. Never answered.

issuer.description:
The OIDC issuer (https); its `/.well-known/openid-configuration` is fetched at sign-in.
ID tokens must be RS256 or ES256 (P-256).

session_seconds.description: Session length after sign-in, 300 to 86400 seconds (default 28800).

ActivityViewerIncident.description: A logging gap as viewers see it: when and what kind, not the operator's notes.

next_cursor.description: Always null: at most 100 incidents per range.

allowed_cidrs.description:
Source networks (`192.0.2.0/24`, `2001:db8::/32`, or one address) that may use viewer
sessions of this project: minted links, invites, SSO sign-ins and vendor previews. Empty =
any address. Outside, every viewer call is a 404. Account tokens keep their own list.

accepted.description: Ingest requests of the last 15 minutes.

ingest_error_pct.description: Ingest error-rate threshold in percent (null: off).

endpoints.description: URL templates of the account logs (relative to the API origin).

witness_quorum.description: Cosignatures a tree head needs before it is published to viewers (0: none).

witnesses.description: Witnesses whose cosignatures count towards `witness_quorum` (C2SP vkeys).

id.description: Null for an operator-wide witness (`WT_ACTIVITY_WITNESSES`), which cannot be removed here.

url.description: C2SP `tlog-witness` URL prefix (`<url>/add-checkpoint`).
`https://` URL prefix of the witness's C2SP tlog-witness API.

vkey.description: Its C2SP verifier key (`<name>+<hex key hash>+<base64(0x04 || Ed25519 key)>`).

quorum.description:
Cosignatures a tree head needs before viewers are served it (0: publish at once). At
most the number of witnesses available.

witnesses.description: Witnesses available (the project's and the operator's); read only.

min_keep_ratio.description: The keep ratio the service is raised to at least.

service.description: `null`: the whole project.

role.description: Omitted: the org's `default_role` setting applies (`read_only` when unset).

user_id.description: `usr_...`; the user must have signed in once.

url.description: `https://` base URL of the server.

normalize.description: Divide each side by its own total (default true).

bytes_30d.description: Estimated stored bytes of the target over the last 30 days.

owner.description: Owner team of that service in the catalog.

series.description: Active series of the metric (0 for non-metric items).

service.description: The service that emits most of it, when known.

est_monthly_saving_usd.description: Sum over every recommendation (not only this page), USD per month.

next_cursor.description: Offset of the next page; null on the last.

proposal.description: The body to `POST …/shaping-rules` (with `mode: preview`) to apply it.

has_replay.description: The session has a recording to open.

inp_trace_id.description: Trace of the slowest INP event, when one is poor.

profile_ids.description: Browser profiles labelled with this session or one of its traces.

trace_ids.description: Up to five backend traces the session's events carry.

run_id.description: The remediation action run an approval started.

selector.description: Label matchers, all of which must equal the agent's labels. `{}` matches every agent.

version.description: Monotonic per project; a rollback creates a new, higher version.

config_version.description: The config version the agent last reported running.

allowed_tools.description: Tools the agent may call; absent means any tool.

allowed_actions.description: Remediation action ids the agent may propose (a person still approves each one).

instructions.description: Operator guidance, at most 8 KiB; enters the prompt below the safety rules.

max_cost_micro.description: Spend per run in micro-USD, 1 to 50 000 000 (default 500 000).

name.description: 1 to 64 characters of letters, digits, `-` and `_`.

peers.description: Agents this one may delegate to: no self, no cycle, chains of at most 3.

tool_bundle.description: Subset of the investigator's tools; unknown names are 422. Empty means all.

triggers.description: Each `"manual"`, `{"alert_labels": {k: v}}` or `{"cron": "m h dom mon dow"}`.

outcome.description: `error` when a model request failed, else `ok`.

top_tools.description: Most used tools, most frequent first (at most 5).

user.description: `user.email`, else `user.account_uuid` (Claude Code), else the span's user id.

AgentUser.description: Adoption of one agent by one user.

AggFilter.description: Span-level filters; all must hold on the same span.

truncated.description: Concurrency read only the first 100,000 spans.

ts_ns.description: Bucket start; present when `granularity_s` is set and a scalar calculation is requested.

AggSpec.description: Flattened into the API request, so it cannot use `deny_unknown_fields`.

granularity_s.description: Bucket width in seconds for time-bucketed rows, heatmap and concurrency (default: auto).

group_by.description: `service.name`, `name`, `status`, or an attribute key; at most 4.

time_saved_s.description: Absent until both groups have 3 resolved incidents and the AI group resolved faster.

with_ai.description: Incidents an investigation named (the incident or one of its alerts) before they were resolved.

allow_pr_creation.description:
Let Watchtower open a draft pull request (new `watchtower/fix-*` branch, never the default
branch) when a `code_fix` proposal is applied. Default false: an issue is filed instead.

cost_micro_usd_low.description: Null when the price book has no row for the model.

price_verified.description: False when the price row is unverified or missing.

id.description: Incident, issue or replay session id, or the profile id.

text.description: Pasted text (`explain_result`, `meeting_notes`, `db_rewrite`).

by_kind.description: `{key, cost_micro_usd, calls}` rows, by `ai_usage.kind` (investigation, eval, judge, ...).

by_user.description: Chargeback by end user and by product feature (empty key: not attributed).

byo_vs_platform.description:
`{byo, platform}`, each `{cost_micro_usd, calls}`: the org's own provider key against the
platform's.

exact.description:
With `quantization: none` and 384, 768, 1024, 1536 or 3072 dimensions the search is
approximate: the HNSW index nominates `limit * 10` candidates that are rescored exactly.
`true` scans every item instead.

metadata.description: Equality filters on metadata keys (at most 8).

quantization.description:
`none` (default) ranks on the Float32 embeddings; `int8` ranks on the int8-quantized copy (a
quarter of the bytes read) and `binary` by Hamming distance on the 1-bit copy (1/32 of the
bytes); both rescore the best candidates exactly.

vector.description: The query embedding; only items with vectors of the same length are compared.

incident_id.description: Required for `:link-incident`: an incident of the same project.
The incident this alert links to; its page holds the postmortem.

truncated.description: More SLOs cover this service than one request measures.

missing.description: What the service lacks; never empty.

window_s.description:
Seconds after a resolve in which a new trigger of the same key reopens the alert, 0 to
604800 (0, the default, turns it off).

default_enabled.description: Installed enabled; a pack alert that is off by default still installs, disabled.

rule.description: A rule document, as `POST /alert-rules` takes it.

delivery.description:
What became of its notifications: `delivered`, `no_route`, `receiver_disabled`,
`unverified` (its receivers page only people with no verified contact method), `failed`
or `skipped_no_contact`; null while pending.

linked_incident.description: The incident this alert belongs to, if any.

repeat_count.description: Triggers deduplicated into this alert, the first included.

muted_by.description: The rule mute, silence, maintenance window or snooze that held the notification.

bundle_window_s.description:
Seconds a user's page notifications on one channel are held and sent as one message,
0 (off, default) to 600.
Absent on PUT: unchanged.

history_days.description: Days of alert history (evaluations and alert events) kept, 30 to 1825 (default 400).

require_resolve_note.description:
Resolving an alert or a page needs a note (`{"note": ...}`; chat and SMS replies are exempt).
Absent on PUT: unchanged.

bad_during_alert.description: Bad events while the alert was open.

budget_used.description: Share of the SLO window's error budget those events spent (1 = all of it).

address.description: An email source's address. Shown once; delete and recreate the source to rotate it.

kind.description: `generic` or `email` (other kinds were made by earlier releases).

undelivered_critical.description:
Firing critical alerts whose notifications reached no one (W31): no route, a disabled or
unverified receiver, a failed delivery, or nobody reachable on call.

missing.description: What is missing, one sentence per piece (empty when every channel works).

ready.description: At least one of email, SMS/voice and push can be delivered.

allowed_cidrs.description: CIDRs (at most 50) every live key of the account must come from; empty lifts the limit.

keys_updated.description: Live keys of the account that now carry the list.

readonly_attested.description: Must be true: the admin attests the tool only reads.

source.description: Annotation source id, empty when no source was named.

dashboard_url.description: Link to a dashboard for this alert; `{{ }}` templates allowed. Reaches notifications.

image_url.description: Your own image for this alert; when set, no chart is captured for it.

panel_url.description: Link to a panel for this alert; `{{ }}` templates allowed. Reaches notifications.

config.description: `{service?, env?, severity_min?, query?}`.

channel.description: Release lane the banner targets; absent: every org.

release_channel.description: The org's release channel, which picked the banners shown.

truncated.description: More than 50 series matched; the rest were dropped.

expected.description: The model's expectation at `ts` (trend plus seasonal profile).

score.description: Residual z (robust) for spikes and dips; the CUSUM statistic for level shifts.

AnomalyCfg.description: The `anomaly` condition. `sensitivity` 0 to 100 (higher flags smaller deviations).

min_count.description:
Absolute floor: nothing is anomalous while both the point and its baseline are below
this count (0: off). Templates set 5 (log anomaly) and 10 (log surge).

min_delta_pct.description: A point must also differ from the baseline by this many percent.

training_days.description: Days of history for the baseline, 7 to 28.

authed.description: Requests that carried an identity (user id, `Authorization`, `appsec.auth`).

authenticated.description: The endpoint authenticates callers (`authed` or `unauthorized` above zero).

documented.description: Listed in the service's imported `OpenAPI` spec; null when the service has none.

pii.description: PII kinds seen in response attributes (`email`, `card`, `ssn`, `phone`, `iban`, `jwt`).

next_cursor.description: Always null: at most 2000 endpoints, by service, route and method.

prefix.description: Not secret: identifies the key in lists.

candidate_endpoint_rules.description: Distinct path templates, usable as APM `endpoint_rules`.

spec_sha.description: Hex SHA-256 of the stored document.

text.description: SQL or `PromQL`; may contain `{{<component id>.value}}` placeholders.

base.description: Null when the base branch has no earlier build (the gate then passes).

name.description: A path prefix inside the package, e.g. `lib/arm64-v8a` or `Frameworks/Foo.framework`.

app_id.description: Bundle id or application id, 1 to 200 characters.

id.description: `[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}`, unique within the app; the name queries reference.

multiline.description: An input: show a multi-line box.

options_query.description: A select's options (one row per option, its first column the value).

query.description: The rows a table or chart shows.

required.description: An input: a button reading it stays disabled while it is empty.

text.description: A text component's content; may contain placeholders.

AppDef.description: An app definition; the create and update request body.

AppField.description: One text field of a form. Its id is a value other components may read, like an input's.

confirm.description: Confirmation prompt the renderer shows before running.

inputs.description: Values for the workflow's manual-trigger inputs; may contain placeholders.

A datastore write (`PUT /datastores/{store}/items/{key}`); `key` and string values may hold
placeholders.

AppSubmit.description: What a form does on submit: a workflow run, a datastore write, or both.

indexes.description: Which variable sets (outputs) to add; default all that succeeded.

target.description: Index of the target whose outputs are kept (default 0).

change.description: What the change is, in words.

installation_id.description: `handoff` and `code_fix`: the GitHub or GitLab installation to file the issue with.

link.description: An https link to the investigation page; evidence ids link to it.

repo.description: `owner/name`; must be one of the installation's repositories for this project.

merged_issues.description: Issues merged into the issue that owns the new fingerprint.

regrouped.description: Fingerprints seen in the last 24 hours (at most 200) that the rules now group differently.

project_id.description: The project the client is granted (read-only).

redirect_to.description: Send the browser here; carries `code` and `state`.

AppsecActor.description: Who a threshold rule counts per.

active.description: False once `expires_at` passed (the entry is pruned a day later).

ttl_s.description: Seconds until the entry stops applying (60 to 31536000); none: until removed.

value.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 address, or a user id as the app reports it (`enduser.id`).

AppsecField.description: A request field a pattern rule reads (percent-decoded once).

AppsecMode.description: SDK behaviour on a pattern match.

AppsecRule.description: One rule. `pattern` rules use `fields` and `pattern`; `threshold` rules use the rest.

enabled.description: Whether the rule runs (effective rulesets and custom rules; default true).

fields.description: Pattern rules: the fields the pattern is matched against.

group_by.description: Threshold rules: count per client IP or per user.

id.description: `[a-z0-9-]{1,64}`; custom rules may not reuse a default id.

method.description: Threshold rules: regex over the HTTP method (none: any).

min_count.description: Threshold rules: requests in one five-minute bucket that raise a signal.

min_distinct.description: Threshold rules: also needs this many distinct users (per IP) or IPs (per user).

name.description: 1 to 100 characters.

pattern.description: Pattern rules: the regex (case-insensitive, portable subset, at most 1000 bytes).

route.description: Threshold rules: regex over the route (`http.route`, else the path; none: any).

severity.description: `low`, `medium`, `high` or `critical`. High and critical signals raise alerts.

status_max.description: Threshold rules: highest counted response status.

status_min.description:
Threshold rules: lowest counted response status (a failed login an SDK reports with
`appsec.login.success = false` counts as 401).

data.description: Default rules (with `enabled` from the configuration), then the custom rules.

next_cursor.description: Always null: the whole ruleset.

distinct_actors.description: Threshold rules: the most distinct users (per IP) or IPs (per user) in one bucket.

sample.description: The matched text (pattern rules) or the count (threshold rules).

signal_key.description: Stable per project, rule and actor.

denylist_id.description: The active denylist entry id for this actor, if any.

next_cursor.description: Always null: at most 500 signals, most recently seen first.

disabled_reason.description: Why the system switched this archive off (`keys shredded`); empty otherwise.

reencrypt.description: Backfill that re-encrypts earlier plaintext days; absent when none ran.

credentials.description: Write-only. Omit to keep the stored credentials on an update.

credentials_ref.description:
`wt+secret://<store>/<path>#<key>` (SEC-011) naming a secret that holds
`{"access_key_id", "secret_access_key"}`; the archiver reads it from the external store.
Replaces sealed credentials; the bucket is not probed at save time.

encrypt.description:
Write objects encrypted with the project's data key so an erasure can shred them (G6-07).
Default: on for a new archive, unchanged on an update. Encrypted objects are not directly
readable in the bucket: use `wtctl archive decrypt` or the object download route. Turning
it on re-encrypts earlier days in the background; archive search cannot read encrypted
archives.

endpoint.description:
S3-compatible endpoint (`MinIO`, R2, GCS interop). Must resolve publicly unless
`allow_private_endpoint` is set.

provider.description:
`s3` (default; also `MinIO` and R2 through `endpoint`), `gcs` (HMAC key pair as the
credentials; endpoint defaults to storage.googleapis.com) or `azure` (credentials:
`access_key_id` = storage account name, `secret_access_key` = base64 account key;
`bucket` = container; `endpoint` defaults to https://<account>.blob.core.windows.net).

sse_kms_key_id.description: KMS key for SSE-KMS on written objects; not a secret. Empty uses the bucket's default.

from.description: RFC 3339; the UTC day picks the first archived partition.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of the log body or span name; empty matches everything.

to.description: RFC 3339; the UTC day picks the last archived partition.

data.description: One JSON object per archived row.

options.description: 2 to 10 distinct choices, each 1 to 100 characters.

download_url.description: Valid for five minutes; the caller still needs read access to the project.

data.description: Pairs whose Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value is at most 0.05, largest effect first.

truncated.description: A side had 50,000 or more matching rows: the statistics use a bounded sample.

hour.description: RFC 3339 start of the hour; absent for range totals.

values.description: One value per key, in `keys` order; `""` where the data lacks the key.

changes.description:
Field-level before/after diff `[{op, path, from, to}]` on an update or delete, with secret
values masked. Absent when the event recorded none.

stuck.description: Still `started` more than 3 minutes after the deploy.

AuditQuery.description: Audit events of the org (the hash chain) seen in the window, one group per action.

actions.description: Exact actions, or a prefix ending in `*` (`member.*`); empty matches every action.

findings.description:
Extra telemetry findings found by the investigator. Up to 50. `first_error_group`,
`affected_users` and `llm_cost` are measured by the server and replace a finding of that kind.

created.description: False when the monitor already had its SLO.

credit_pct.description: Service credit owed at this uptime (policies only).

rule_group.description: Rule group holding the recording rule.

step_s.description: Seconds between points; default the group interval.

repos.description: Repositories the installation maps to this project.

only_a.description: RFC 3339 times A fired and B did not.

incident_times.description: RFC 3339 times past incidents were declared; each is scored for detection lead time.

lead_window_s.description: Firings this many seconds either side of an incident count as detecting it (default 3600).

rule_a.description: Version A as a spec (not saved). Give this or `rule_id_a`.

to.description: RFC 3339, exclusive; at most 30 days after `from`, at most now.

est_notifications.description:
Notifications the router would send, from the project's routing tree timers (an upper
bound: alerts of different groups are not merged).

firing_seconds.description: Seconds groups spent firing, summed over groups.

incomplete.description: The replay hit its deadline; the rest of the range was not replayed.

total.description: Evaluations the replay runs in all.

rule.description: The rule to replay (not saved). Give this or `rule_id`.

rule_id.description: A saved rule of this project to replay.

to.description: RFC 3339, exclusive; at most 30 days after `from`, at most now.

signals.description: Signals the rule would have raised (one per entity per window).

truncated.description: True when the row cap cut the replay short: the counts are a lower bound.

windows_with_rows.description: Windows that held at least one matching row.

window_start.description: RFC 3339 start of the window that raised it.

Returned once, by enable. `token` is never stored or shown again; the badge URLs are
`/v1/badges/{token}/uptime.svg` and `/v1/badges/{token}/status.svg`.

BandPoint.description: A forecast point with its band.

limit.description:
Items to use, 1 to 50 (default 50). Each item input is the opening message (a string, or
an object with `opening`).

model.description: Model id, at most 100 characters of letters, digits and -_.:/@.

monthly_cap_usd.description: Monthly cap of this feature in USD, 0 to the org cap; omit for no feature cap.

provider_key_id.description: An active provider key of the org; omit for the org's default key.

bindings.description: At most one entry per kind; a kind that is absent uses the org default model.

date.description: When the commit was made (RFC 3339, as the SCM reports it).

file_level.description: The SCM has no line blame: the commit is the newest one that touched the file.

frames.description: Blamed frames that point at this commit.

lines.description: Lines near the blamed frame lines this commit last changed.

pull_urls.description: Pull or merge requests that contain the commit.

score.description: Lines over frame depth, times recency (halved at 30 days); higher is more suspect.

cached.description: True when answered from the cache.

release.description: The release the event carried ('' for none); the cache key with the issue.

`https` URL that receives `POST {input}` and answers `{output}`; checked at save and

config.description:
Kind settings. saml: `idp_entity_id`, `idp_sso_url`, `idp_slo_url`, `idp_certs` (PEM),
`metadata_xml` or `metadata_url` (filled in from `IdP` metadata), `sp_cert_pem`,
`want_assertions_signed`, `allow_idp_initiated`, `force_authn`, `email_attr` (matches the
attribute's `Name`, never `FriendlyName`, as `groups_attr` does), `allow_sha1` (legacy:
accepts SHA-1 digests and signatures, which can be forged with effort; leave off),
`allow_encrypted_assertions` (off by default; RSA decryption of unauthenticated input, see
RUSTSEC-2023-0071; TLS already protects the POST; needs `decryption_secret` and
`sp_decryption_cert_pem`). The `IdP` must send a stable `NameID`
(persistent or email that is never reassigned); transient is refused. ldap: `url`
(`ldaps://` or `ldap://`), `start_tls`, `allow_plain`, `ca_pem`, `bind_dn`, `user_base_dn`,
`user_filter` (with `{username}`), `email_attr`, `member_of_attr`, `group_base_dn`,
`group_filter` (with `{dn}`), `timeout_secs`. jwt: `jwks_url`, `issuer`, `audience`,
`header`, `login_claim`, `email_claim`, `url_login`. proxy: `header`, `email_header`,
`groups_header`, `trusted_proxies` (CIDRs). github: `client_id`, `host` (GitHub Enterprise
Server base URL; default github.com), `allowed_orgs`, `allowed_teams` (`org/team-slug`; at
least one entry between them), with the client secret as `secret`; mappings match org names
and `org/team-slug`.

decryption_secret.description:
SAML: the RSA key (PEM) that decrypts assertions, sealed like `secret` and never returned.
Must differ from the signing key. Omit on update to keep the stored one.

default_role.description: Role of users in no mapped group: `engineer` or `read_only` (default).

groups_attr.description: Attribute, claim or header naming the groups (default `groups`; LDAP `memberOf`).

kind.description: `saml`, `ldap`, `jwt`, `proxy` or `github`; ignored on update (the kind never changes).

secret.description:
saml: the SP private key (PEM); ldap: the bind password. Sealed, never returned. Omit on
update to keep the stored one.

message.description: What was checked or what failed (never a secret).

service.description: The `service` value the findings are listed under.

skipped.description: SBOM entries with no OSV ecosystem (rpm, generic, no purl, ...).

`voice`, `push`, `email`, `slack`, `teams`, `telegram`, `mattermost`, `webhook`) instead
of their personal rules; a user with none of them keeps their rules.

live_shares.description: Live public share links of that dashboard.

pinned.description: Pinned version; null follows the latest (and changes with the next save).

report_schedules.description: Report schedules that render that dashboard.

data.description: Dashboards (at most 500) using the panel.

following_latest.description: How many of them follow the latest version (a save changes these).

panel.description: A dashboard panel object (spec v2), without `library`.

version.description: The version `panel` is.

license.description: `{id, org_id | "*", plan, limits, valid_from, valid_to, key_id}`; times are unix seconds.

signature.description: Unpadded base64url Ed25519 signature over the canonical license JSON.

kind.description: `real`, `test`, `tutorial` or `retrospective`; the last three are left out of analytics.

paused.description: A paused incident sends no SLA reminders.

sub_status.description: One of the type's sub-statuses for the current status; empty clears it.

LimitedQuery.description: A query allowed at most once per `allowed_frequency_s` per project.

upstream_jobs.description: Jobs that produce `node` (or the job named `node`).

upstream_tables.description: Distinct upstream tables (the union of the upstream jobs' inputs).

inputs.description: The tables this job reads (its inputs): the upstream of `node`.

status.description: The HTTP status the webhook answered with.

oper_status.description:
LLDP/CDP links: ifOperStatus of the reporting port (`up`, `down`, `testing`, `unknown`,
`dormant`, `notPresent`, `lowerLayerDown`) as last polled.

status_at.description: RFC 3339 time of the last status report; an old one means the state is stale.

utilization.description: LLDP/CDP links: the busier direction's traffic over the port speed, 0 to 1.

LinkEntry.description: A span link: another span this one is causally related to (e.g. a batch parent).

incident_id.description: The other incident, in this project.

kind.description:
`related`, `caused_by` (the incident in the path was caused by the other) or `duplicate`
(the one in the path duplicates the other).

resolved.description: Present when the list was asked for a `field` and `value`.

LinkedFrom.description: A span in this project that links to a trace.

broken_propagation.description: Hops where trace context was lost.

orphans.description: Spans whose parent is not in the trace.

partial.description: The trace has more spans than one lint reads; findings cover the first 20 000.

truncated_spans.description: Spans cut short by the span limits (`wt.truncated`).

on_call_now.description: Who is on call right now, per schedule (shadows left out).

unacked_pages.description: Pages still waiting for an acknowledgement.

sample_annotations.description:
Summary, description and runbook URL rendered for the first series at its last value,
as a notification would show them.

series_truncated.description: More label groups matched than are drawn.

template_warnings.description: Labels the templates read that no previewed series has (they would render empty).

threshold.description: The rule's threshold condition (`op`, `value`), when it has one: draw it as a line.

rule.description: The draft rule (not saved). Give this or `rule_id`.

active_users.description: Distinct identified users among the active sessions (anonymous sessions do not count).

span_s.description: Seconds between the first and the last call.

span_id.description: All zeros for a trace-level score.

value.description: A number, a boolean or a string, by `data_type`.
