baseline.description: The median of the series (spike / drop) or of its first third (trends).

values.description: `[unix_seconds, "value"]` pairs, as the metrics routes return them.

labels.description: `by (...)` fields, plus `p` (quantile) or `le` (bucket bound in seconds).

day.description: RFC 3339 start of the UTC day.

SeriesQuota.description: Active series against the project's `max_series` quota.

warning.description: More than 80% of `max` is in use.

SeriesQuotaRequest.description: Series caps of the project's metrics.

max_series.description: Active series allowed in the project (1 to 100,000,000).

per_metric.description: Series allowed per metric name (1 to `max_series`).

ServiceDora.description: One service's DORA metrics, for the per-service breakdown.

kind.description: Signal class, derived at read time (not stored): `app`, `infra`, `job` or `ci`.

evidence.description: `trace_id` when derived from the spans of a trace or span anchor, else `time_window_inferred`.

ServiceKind.description: Signal class of a service, derived from its name and the signals it carries (W65).

to.description: The service name to store the span under.

level.description:
Highest maturity level (1 to 3) whose rules, and every lower level's, all pass; 0 when
even level 1 has a failing rule. A level with no rules counts as reached.

score.description: 0 to 100: passed weight over total weight (100 when there are no rules).

ServiceStatus.description: Derived status of a service from the open incidents that list it.

business_services.description: Business services that list the service (the dependency view), with sibling status.

status.description:
`operational` (no open incident), `degraded` (worst open is SEV3 or SEV4) or `major`
(SEV1 or SEV2).

anomalies.description: Open anomaly insights of the last 24 hours.

firing.description: Open firing alerts labelled with the service.

slo_burning.description: SLOs of the service whose burn rule is firing.

ServiceUnit.description: One service's cost next to its RED request count.

added.description: False when the incident already listed the service.

paged.description: A page for the owners' on-call policy was created (once per incident and service).

clamped_range.description: Deprecated alias of `partial` containing `range_clamped`; removed after Phase 3.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass back as `cursor` for the next page.

partial.description: Why the result may be incomplete; null when it is complete.

truncated.description: Deprecated alias of `partial` containing `row_cap`; removed after Phase 3.

diff.description: Attributes that differ (ids and timestamps excluded).

data.description: The session's events in time order, at most 5000 across all pages.

lucida_replay_url.description:
The session in Lucida (`<host>/replays/<id>`); null without a configured host or a
`lucida.session_id` from the SDK.

posthog.description:
Deep links into `PostHog`, from the ids the SDK stored; null when the project has no
`PostHog` settings or the session has no ids.

trace_id.description: 32 hex chars; null when the event has no trace.

action_ids.description: Remediation action ids; replaces the attached set (at most 20).

dashboard_id.description: A dashboard id, or null to clear.

saved_query_id.description: A saved query of this kind that the caller can see.

env_id.description: An `env_…` id or an environment name; `environment` is the older name of this field.

protected.description:
`true` protects the label, `false` lifts it, absent keeps it. Setting or lifting
protection, and moving a protected label, needs a project admin.

user_ids.description: The complete member list (user ids); everyone must belong to the org.

unit.description: A unit such as `seconds`, `bytes` or `requests` (at most 64 characters).

full_retention_days.description: Days a captured payload is kept, 1 to 400 (the row's `ClickHouse` TTL).

media_capture.description: Move base64 images, audio and files out of payloads into object storage.

media_retention_days.description: Days media objects are kept, 1 to 30.

redact_patterns.description: At most 50 regexes masked in captured payloads, validated at save.

sample_rate.description: Share of traces whose payload is captured, 0 to 1. Metadata rows are never sampled.

env_pattern.description:
Regex on the environment name; the last capture group is the PR number.
Default `^(pr|preview)-(\d+)$`.

pr_check_status.description: Also post a `watchtower/perf` commit status on the PR (default off).

ttl_hours.description: Hours a preview environment lives after its PR closes (1 to 720, default 72).

finished_at.description: RFC 3339; default now. Kept from the first call when repeated.

archived.description: Hidden from pickers; incidents at this level keep it.

color.description: `#rrggbb` or empty for the default colour.

data.description: All four levels, `SEV1` first.

spend_anomaly.description: Spend anomaly, as a ratio over the forecast.

data.description: The customised levels; levels left out return to their defaults.

matched_fires.description: Datadog firings that have a Watchtower firing at the same time.

monitors.description: Counted from `data` on upload; whatever the client sends is ignored.

window_days.description: Length of the compared period, 1 to 30 days.

match.description: Boolean pipeline expression selecting records (all records when absent).

auto_apply.description:
`off` (default), `preview` (accept new suggestions in preview) or `enabled` (also promote
a clean preview to enabled after 7 days).

match.description: `{expr, params}` of the rule accepting it would create.

share_pct.description: Share of the total cost, percent; the shares sum to 100 (0 when there is no usage).

share_id.description: The share whose link is sent.

token.description: The link as returned at creation (tokens are not stored, so the caller supplies it).

expires_in_s.description: Lifetime in seconds: default 86400 (24 h), at most 604800 (7 d).

emails.description: Lowercased addresses (at most 100); empty opens the link to anyone holding it.

token.description: Shown once; only its SHA-256 is stored. Open it at `GET /v1/shared/replays/{token}`.

ShiftList.description: The materialized shifts in a window (at most 92 days, 5000 shifts).

url.description: The short app link: `/s?project={prj}&code={code}`.

project_id.description: One project of the org; every project of the org when omitted.

reason.description: Why (kept in the audit event); at most 200 characters.

projects.description: Projects whose archive key is now destroyed (including ones already shredded).

series.description: Services, log series, saved forecasts or recent deployments the last pass looked at.

warm.description: How many of them have enough history to be judged.

SignalLimit.description: One signal's limits; 0 inherits the credential-wide limit.

assignee.description: A user id or email; empty string clears it.

skipped.description: The deadline was spent before this signal ran.

value_box_applied.description: The selection's value-axis box filtered this signal.

Signals.description: The measurements the score and health are derived from.

confidence.description: `high`, or `low` when a window held fewer requests than the gate's minimum.

error_rate_pp.description: Error rate change in percentage points; null without enough traffic.

new_issues.description: Issues first seen in this release since the deploy.

p95_change_pct.description: p95 latency change in percent; null without enough traffic or a baseline.

throughput_before_rpm.description: Requests per minute before and after the deploy.

throughput_drop_pct.description: Percent the request count fell (negative when it rose); null without enough traffic.

data.description:
New proposals. Signals below their threshold, or that already have an open proposal,
create none.

public_key.description: Base64 of the 32-byte Ed25519 public key; `null` removes verification.

required.description:
Reject unsigned requests (needs `public_key`). Default false: signatures are checked when
present.

name.description: The same text as `comment`, under the name other resources use.

matching_7d.description: Alerts open at any time in the last 7 days that they match (open ones included).

matching_now.description: Alerts open now that the matchers match.

ends_at.description: RFC 3339, after `starts_at`, at most one year later.

matchers.description: Alerts whose labels match all of these are silenced (at least one, at most 20).

confirmed_causes.description:
Confirmed root causes of past investigations (user-confirmed or from a published
postmortem) near the target, recency weighted, best first, at most 3.

data.description:
Issues, incidents, alerts, postmortems and runbooks within Hamming distance 10 (of 64
bits) of the target, best first, with their outcome and resolution text.

after.description: null where the pipeline dropped the record.

by.description: `trace_id`, or an attribute key whose value is hashed.

from.description: RFC 3339; default one hour before `to`. The window is at most 1 hour.

keep_errors.description: Keep every trace with an ERROR span regardless of `rate`.

keep_slower_than_ms.description: Keep every trace whose slowest span is at least this long, regardless of `rate`.

rate.description: Share of traces the head rule keeps, 0 to 1.

monthly_allotment_bytes.description: The plan's monthly byte allotment; adds the projected share of it to the result.

conversation_id.description: Shared `gen_ai.conversation.id` of the spans of the conversation.

transcript.description: `[{role: user|assistant, content}]`; `user` is the simulated user.

target.description: `{model, system?, provider_key_id?, max_tokens?}` or `{http: {url}}` (https, public host).

shift_ns.description: Nanoseconds to add to the span's start so it sits inside its parent (duration unchanged).

instructions.description: Operator guidance, at most 8 KiB. Enters the system prompt below the safety rules.

name.description: 1 to 64 characters of letters, digits, `-` and `_`.

tool_allow.description: Subset of the investigator's tools; unknown names are 422. Empty means all.

triggers.description: Each `"manual"`, `{"alert_labels": {k: v}}` or `{"cron": "m h dom mon dow"}`.

changed_files.description:
Repository-relative paths the change touches (e.g. `git diff --name-only base...HEAD`).
Without them nothing is skippable.

skippable.description:
Test Impact Analysis: tests whose recorded files the change does not touch, excluding
disabled tests (which never run anyway).

ack_min.description: Minutes after declaration by which the incident must leave triage.

update_every_min.description: Minutes between updates while the incident is open.

SlaHours.description: Business hours: counted time is `start..end` local on the listed ISO weekdays (1 = Monday).

cause_alert.description: The alert that caused the downtime.

business_hours.description: Only these hours count (null: all time).

slo_ids.description: SLO ids the policy covers (1 to 50).

Sli.description: What counts as good and total events.

oneOf.description:
Two counts over the window. A `PromQL` query is an instant query at the window end that may
use `$window`; its series are summed. `LogCount` counts matching log rows.

request_ratio.description:
Two counts over the window. A `PromQL` query is an instant query at the window end that may
use `$window`; its series are summed. `LogCount` counts matching log rows.

oneOf.description:
Requests of a service (one endpoint, or all when empty) at or under `threshold_ms`, from
the RED rollups.

latency.description:
Requests of a service (one endpoint, or all when empty) at or under `threshold_ms`, from
the RED rollups.

oneOf.description: Uptime-monitor results that are up; maintenance results are not counted.

availability.description: Uptime-monitor results that are up; maintenance results are not counted.

oneOf.description:
Entry-span requests of a service (one endpoint, or all when empty) that did not end in
an error, from the RED rollups.

error_ratio.description:
Entry-span requests of a service (one endpoint, or all when empty) that did not end in
an error, from the RED rollups.

oneOf.description:
Evaluation ticks of an alert rule (a monitor) in which it is not firing, from the rule
evaluation history; ticks without data or in error count in neither.

monitor_state.description:
Evaluation ticks of an alert rule (a monitor) in which it is not firing, from the rule
evaluation history; ticks without data or in error count in neither.

oneOf.description:
Slices of `slice_s` seconds in which `query op threshold` holds (a range query stepped by
`slice_s`; with several series, every one must hold).

window_based.description:
Slices of `slice_s` seconds in which `query op threshold` holds (a range query stepped by
`slice_s`; with several series, every one must hold).

SloBurn.description:
The query of a `slo_burn` rule: 1 while its mode holds, else 0. Managed rules use the tier's
multiwindow pairs; a user rule picks an exhaustion-time or budget-rate mode (the tier then only
names its urgency). The SLO itself (objective, SLIs, corrections) is loaded when evaluated.

min_events.description:
Fewest events a measured (long) window needs before the rule may fire (default
`DEFAULT_MIN_EVENTS`; 0 turns the guard off). Below it the SLO has `insufficient_data`.

SloBurnMode.description: How a `slo_burn` rule decides that it fires.

oneOf.description: The tier's multiwindow burn-rate pairs (the managed page and ticket rules).

The budget left in the current period runs out within `within_h` hours at the burn rate
of the recent lookback (a quarter of the horizon, 5 minutes to 1 day).
At least `drop_pct` percent of the period's whole budget was spent in the last `window_s`.
At least `pct` percent of the current period's budget is used up (ALT-005).

A user burn-rate pair: both the `long_s` and the `short_s` window burn faster than `factor`
(ALT-005; the managed tiers use fixed pairs).

derived_metrics.description: Metrics created for this SLO from a log pattern or trace attribute.

page_rule_id.description: The managed alert rules (`slo_burn`) for the page and ticket tiers.

SloProposeProposal.description: A proposed SLO; send it to `POST /slos` to accept it.

observed.description: The good ratio the last 30 days actually had.

SloSpec.description:
Everything about an SLO that a user sets. Give `sli` for a request or window SLO, or
`children` for a composite (the weighted mean of its children's good ratios).

children.description: Composite only: 1 to 10 non-composite SLOs of this project, each in its own environment.

deploy_window_s.description:
Length of a deploy window after the deployment finished (or started, while running),
60 to 86400 seconds; default 900.

exclude_deploy_windows.description:
Exclude failures during deploy windows: each deployment of the SLO's environment and
service (a deployment without a service matches all) is left out of good and total, like
a correction, in burn rules, the budget and reports. Default true, so a failed check during
a rollout does not burn budget; send false to count deploy-time failures.

service.description: Catalog service the SLO belongs to.

sli.description:
`latency` thresholds must be one of 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000, 2500, 5000, 10000
or 30000 ms (422 otherwise); `window_based` slices are 60 to 300 s.

window_days.description:
7, 28, 30 or 90. With a calendar `window` it is ignored (the period is the week, month or
quarter, UTC).

data.description: Services with traffic in the last 30 days and no SLO, busiest first.

total.description: Services with traffic, and how many of them have an SLO.

SlowTest.description: Duration statistics of one test over the range.

total_ms.description: Summed duration: the CI time the test costs over the range.

tls.description: Must be true: plain SMTP is refused.

detail.description: Short reason when not ok; never the password.

until.description: RFC 3339; at most seven days from now. Give this or `minutes`.

author.description: Untrusted repository text, as are `date` and `summary`.

sha.description: The commit that last changed the line.

summary.description: First line of the commit message.

peer.description: Name of a federation peer; absent for a project of this cluster.

lines.description: Untrusted repository text, one entry per line.

source_url.description: The frame's line in the repository's web UI; absent when the ref is not a commit.

bytes_est.description: Estimated: body or name plus attribute keys and values.

service.description: `service.name`; empty when unset.

origins.description: `https://host[:port]` origins scripts and maps may be fetched from.
At most 20 `https://host[:port]` origins; turning fetching on needs at least one.

latency_bounds_ns.description: `[lo, hi)` duration of each latency row (half-octave log buckets), ascending, contiguous.

events.description: Span events (exceptions, logs on the span), oldest first.

has_profile.description: Profile samples carry this span's id (`GET .../spans/{span}/profile` opens them).

incomplete.description: The parent span is not in this trace (dropped, sampled out or not yet arrived).

parent_span_id.description: All zeros for a root span.

dimensions.description: At most 5 span attribute keys to group by.

name.description: `[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}`; series are `traces.span.custom.<name>.calls` and `.duration`.

retention_days.description: Retention of the series, 1 to 3650 days (default 450).

flame_url_params.description: Query parameters of `GET .../profiles/flame` that open this link.

parent_span_id.description: All zeros for a root span.

deploys.description: Deploys in the same window, to draw beside the buckets.

fingerprints.description:
Fingerprints (64 hex chars, from `…/fingerprints`) that move to a new issue. The issue
keeps at least one.

version.description: Current version (unchanged when no item moved).

value_box.description: Value-axis box in milliseconds (selection only): span and LLM-call duration, session LCP.

selection.description: The region under investigation (a chart box).

data.description: Attribute/value pairs of all signals, the largest effect first.

overlay.description: Hits whose attribute is a dimension of a correlation group of the project.

frames.description: Result name (`A`..`Z`, optionally with up to three more letters or digits) to its data.

sql.description: One `SELECT` over the results by name, e.g. `SELECT A.ts, A.value / B.value FROM A JOIN B USING ts`.

from.description: RFC 3339; default one hour before `to`. Every table is bounded to `[from, to)`.

max_rows.description:
1 to 100000 (default 10000). Above 10000 counts against the caller's hourly budget of
1,000,000 extra rows (429 when spent).

sql.description: One `SELECT` over the tables listed by `GET /sql/tables`.

clamped_range.description: Deprecated alias of `partial` containing `range_clamped`; removed after Phase 3.

columns.description: Column names in `SELECT` order (empty when no row matched).

data.description: One array of values per row.

partial.description: Why the result may be incomplete; null when it is complete.

plan.description: With `?explain=1`: the `ClickHouse` execution plan, one line per entry; no rows are read.

truncated.description: Deprecated alias of `partial` containing `row_cap`; removed after Phase 3.

config.description: Connection settings (never the credential).

name.description: Query name: `POST /v1/projects/{prj}/datasources/{name}/query`.

query_access.description: Who may run SQL on it: `admin`, `editors` or `viewers`.

config.description:
postgres/mysql/mssql: `host`, `port`, `database`, `user`, `ssl_mode` (default
`verify-full` / `VERIFY_IDENTITY`), `ca_pem` (every engine), `trust_server_certificate` (mssql).
clickhouse: `url` (https), `database`, `user`. bigquery: `project_id`, `location`.

engine.description: Ignored on update (the engine never changes).

max_rows.description: Rows returned at most (1 to 100 000, default 10 000).

query_access.description:
Who may run SQL on it: `admin` (`ManageConnectors`, the default for a new source), `editors`
(`EditDashboards`) or `viewers` (`ReadTelemetry`). Omit on update to keep it.

secret.description: Password, or the `BigQuery` service-account JSON key. Sealed; omit on update to keep it.

timeout_ms.description: Query timeout (100 ms to 120 s, default 10 s).

message.description: What failed (the server's message), or that `SELECT 1` answered.

break_glass_user_ids.description: At most two members (`usr_` ids) who may sign in without SSO.

default_project_ids.description: Project ids of this organization (`prj_`; bare UUIDs are accepted too).

jit_role.description: Default `read_only`; `org_admin` and `project_admin` are stored but join as `engineer`.

domain_challenge.description: Publish this as a TXT record at `_watchtower-challenge.<domain>`.

signal.description: `traces`: append these to the traces pipeline's `stages`.

template_id.description:
Recorded with the update. Email subscribers get it rendered through the project's
`incident_update` template (a default ships). At most 100 characters.

last_used_at.description: RFC 3339; absent when it was never used.

owner.description: User id of the creator or owner, when known.

incident_label.description: Issue label that marks an incident (default `incident`).

since_days.description: How far back to import, 1-730 days (default 90).

ci.description: The CI job that started the run; recorded on the run.

monitor_ids.description:
Run exactly these monitors (`mon_…`) instead of a tag. Ids not in this project are
silently absent (404-equivalent, never 403).

overrides.description: CI overrides applied to every monitor in the run; recorded on the run.

tag.description:
Monitors tagged with this (see `PUT …/check-tags/{tag}`); default `ci`. Ignored when
`monitor_ids` is given.

self_ns.description: Nanoseconds inside the spans not covered by their children.

StatementCaller.description: One service that issues a statement (the statement backtrace: who calls this query).

alerts_in.description: Matched alerts and events fed to the rule.

compression.description: `alerts_in / cases_out` (1.0 when nothing matched): how much paging the rule saves.

sub_statuses.description: Custom sub-statuses an incident in this status may carry.

milestones.description: Ordered milestone names (for `MTTx`); each is recorded after the one before it.

status.description: `muted` (triaged, not a real risk here) or `fixed` (handled out of band).

incidents.description: Incidents that spent any time in the status.

mean_s.description: Mean seconds those incidents spent in it (an open one counts up to now).

error_traces.description: Traces at this step with an errored span, and up to 5 of them (error drilldown).

matched_traces.description: Traces in which this step and all earlier ones matched in order.

slowest_trace_ids.description: Up to 5 traces at this step, slowest step span first (latency drilldown).

reached.description: Sessions that started the journey and reached this step.

sas_token.description: `azure`: a SAS token with read and list permission on the inventory container.

service_account.description: `gcp`: the service-account key (the JSON key file, as an object or a string).

config.description:
`inventory_bucket`, `prefix`, `role_arn`, `region`, `data_region`, `account`, `fields`;
never secrets.

ended_at.description: Absent while the storm is still going.

suppressed.description: Notifications held back and replaced by digests.

parent_id.description: The incident this stream belongs to.

key.description: Attribute key; default `user.id` (`enduser.id` is erased too).

kind.description: `user` (a user id), `team` (a team id) or `role` (a built-in role name or custom role id).

service.description: Set for a service subscription.

subscriber.description: One of `{"receiver": id}`, `{"team": slug}`, `{"user": id}` or `{"email": address}`, plus optional `min_severity` and `min_interval_s`.

email.description: An address (at most 254 characters). Updates are emailed with a single-use unsubscribe link.

min_interval_s.description: Cadence: at most one update per this many seconds (60 to 86400).

min_severity.description: Cadence: only updates of an incident at least this severe (`SEV1` most severe).

team.description: A team slug with a default receiver; the update goes to that receiver.

user.description: A project member, reached through their verified email or push contact methods.

events.description:
1 to 30 of an event type, `alert.*` style groups (`alert`, `issue`, `incident`,
`deployment`, `monitor`) or `*`.

receiver_id.description:
A sink receiver of the project (`webhook`, `kafka_rest`, `s3`, `sns`, `mqtt` or `posthog`);
deliveries are signed and retried like alerts.

evidence.description:
Always `same_service_time_window_inferred`: the alert's `service` label is one of the
incident's services and the incident was active within 30 minutes of the alert.

ref.description: Pass to `GET …/trace-test-runs?ref=` to follow the run.

version.description: The API build.

interval_name.description: Named time interval of the project; pages below `threshold` wait for it. Null = no deferral.

max_first_audible_delay_min.description:
Minimum notification policy: a member's audible rules must start within this many minutes
(0 to 1440, default 1440).

threshold.description: `warning`, `high` or `critical`: pages ranking below it are deferred (default `high`).

factor.description: Surge factor over the window's mean per minute, 1.5 to 1000.

group_by.description: 1 to 4 keys: `service`, `host` (resource `host.name`), `level` or any attribute key.

min_count.description: Lines a minute needs before it can surge, at least 1.

name.description: 1 to 100 characters.

window_minutes.description: Minutes the mean looks back over, 5 to 1440.

author.description: Author name from git blame (untrusted repository text); absent for release commits.

author_email.description: The commit author, a candidate to ask or assign.

commit_url.description: The commit in the repository's web UI (blame suspects).

evidence.description:
`commit_touched_frame_file` (the release commit touched a file in the stack),
`blame_frame_line` (git blame names the commit for a frame line) or `blame_frame_file` (the
newest commit of a frame's file, for SCMs without blame). Evidence, not a finding that the
commit caused the error.

pull_urls.description: Pull or merge requests that contain the commit (blame suspects).

score.description: Sum over in-app frames of 1 / frame depth for frames whose file the commit touched.

before.description: The anchor the change precedes: `first_seen`, or the start of a spike (RFC 3339).

url.description: The provider's page of the change.

score.description: 0 to 1: share of the issue's events with the flag x closeness of the newest change.

suspect.description: True when the flag changed in the window before the issue was first seen or a spike.

data.description: Suspects first, by score.

spikes.description:
Starts of the later hourly spikes of the issue's events (newest 5 in 14 days), oldest
first; changes before them count like changes before first seen.

data.description:
Release-commit suspects (at most 3, best first), then the cached git-blame suspects of the
newest release blamed (at most 5, see `POST .../suspects/blame`), without repeating a sha.

next_cursor.description: Always null: the list never has a second page.

kind.description: `microsoft`, `debuginfod` or `custom` (a mirror with the debuginfod layout).

applied.description: True when the connector applied the file (apply mode).

sha.description: Commit the file was read at.

clamped_range.description: Deprecated alias of `partial` containing `range_clamped`; removed after Phase 3.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass back as `cursor` for the next page.

partial.description: Why the result may be incomplete; null when it is complete.

truncated.description: Deprecated alias of `partial` containing `row_cap`; removed after Phase 3.

monitor_ids.description: `mon_...` ids of this project; replaces the tag's monitors.

code_location.description: `file:line` of the sink, for the code link.

trace_id.description: Trace the detection happened on (lowercase hex), for the trace link.

vuln_type.description:
The sink class the taint reached: `sql_injection`, `command_injection`, `path_traversal`,
`open_redirect`, ...

module.description: Module name as in the agent's health components (`prometheus_scrape`, `ebpf_trace`, ...).

model.description: Model sent to this provider; empty uses the model the client asked for.

provider_key_id.description: An org provider key (`/v1/orgs/{org}/llm/provider-keys`); omit for the org's BYO key.

weight.description: Share of first attempts with `routing: weighted`, 1 to 100; omitted counts as 1.

http.description: Instead of a prompt: call the customer's endpoint.

prompt.description: A registry prompt (`id` plus `version` or `label`); the template is pinned at creation.

kind.description:
`kubernetes` (the operator re-injects and rolls the workload) or `host` (the agent switches
the host-wide auto-instrumentation).

service.description: The `service.name` to upgrade.

config.description: `{org, api_base?, prune}` for GitHub, `{instance_url, prune}` for `ServiceNow`.

version.description: Starts at 1; goes up when the body changes.

`update_incident`, `add_timeline_note`, `page`, `create_jira_issue`, `create_slack_channel`,
`post_slack_message`, `run_query`, `start_postmortem`, `wait` (`seconds` 1 to 900) and
`trigger_workflow` (chains at most 3 deep). A step may repeat with `loop` (`over` a JSON
path, `over_expr` a CEL list or `until` a CEL condition with `max_iterations`); action
`loop` runs `loop.steps` per iteration. `${$.json.path}` in a string parameter is
replaced from the event payload. The caller needs the permission of every action.

resolved,assigned}`, `incident.{declared,status_changed,severity_changed,field_changed,
resolved}`, `deployment.created`, `monitor.{down,up}`) and optional `conditions`: an
expression of `eq`, `ne`, `in`, `contains`, `startsWith`, `matches` (RE2), `and`, `or` and
`not` over `JSONPath` into the event payload (at most 4 KiB, 16 levels).
